description: Central Province - Central Provincial Road Passenger Carriage Services Statute
reasoning: The gazette content primarily concerns the enactment of a new provincial statute (Central Provincial Road Passenger Carriage Services Statute No. 03 of 2018) that establishes a transport services authority, rescinds previous statutes, and creates a regulatory framework for passenger transport services in the Central Province. This fits the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves new regulations, statutory instruments, and legal frameworks for transport management, rather than focusing on government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
